title: Script Progress: deltas.json
description: Numeric series for the Delta Tracker: one property per metric name, each holding its points oldest first. Written by track_delta() / trackDelta(); the reporter keeps the last 50 points per metric.

additionalProperties.description: Points for one metric, oldest first. The property name is the metric name used in scriptProgress.deltaTracker.metrics, .formats and .thresholds.

deltaPoint.description: One recorded value of a tracked metric.

date.description: ISO timestamp of when the value was recorded. The sparkline plots points in this order.

value.description: The numeric value. Compared against scriptProgress.deltaTracker.thresholds to decide whether it is out of range.

task.description: Name of the task that recorded the value, so a metric tracked by several scripts can still be attributed.

runId.description: Id of the run that recorded the point. Two points sharing a runId are one run measuring the same thing twice — a value found and the value after a fix — and the chart reads them as "found X, resolved to Y" rather than as two unrelated dots.
